; tap-page-turn.qmd - tap on the left/right edge of the screen turns the page.
; Two ingatellent mods glued into one file, no loader, no dependency:
;   scrollScreenUpOrDown.qmd  - scroll and page-change functions (DocumentView)
;   tapToChangeViewOrPage.qmd - edge tap calls them (SceneViewGestures)
; Source: https://github.com/ingatellent/xovi-qmd-extensions, commit 17720f5, folder 3.29
; Original author: ingatellent. SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0
; Toolbar button: when the toolbar is shown, taps turn pages only while
; the button is on. Button, menu entries and the tool-count fix are taken
; from touchLock.qmd by Mitchell Scott (GPL-3.0-only), icons in assets.
; Built for firmware 3.29.1. For a new firmware take fresh files from the
; same repo and glue them again in the same order.
AFFECT [[11806562588218124596]]
	TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
			INSERT {
function scrollToBottom() {
    ~&214622607920&~ ~&3012200093845531741&~ = ~&6504254477&~.~&8399340108982949229&~.~&13955160320170978486&~.~&7082729686082&~;

    ~&6504254477&~.~&502817364213021138&~.~&8399804544299345782&~(~&5971598&~.~&214638019283&~(0,offsetFromNearScrollCenter > 1 ? -offsetFromNearScrollCenter : 0 ));
}

        ~&214622607920&~ visibleHeight = ~&7082729686082&~ / ~&6504254477&~.~&502817364213021138&~.~&214641137009&~;
        ~&214622607920&~ upperCenter = visibleHeight / 2;

        ~&5972376&~ (visibleHeight > ~&3012200093845531741&~) {

            ~&7083121450889&~ upperCenter;

    ~&214622607920&~ offsetFromNearScrollCenter = (nearScrollCenter - ~&6504254477&~.~&502817364213021138&~.~&7082534202858&~.~&180994&~) * ~&6504254477&~.~&502817364213021138&~.~&214641137009&~;
    ~&5972376&~(~&6504254477&~.~&502817364213021138&~.~&7082534202858&~.~&180994&~ > 0.9*~&6504254477&~.~&8399340108982949229&~.~&13955160320170978486&~.~&7082729686082&~ - ~&7082729686082&~ / ~&6504254477&~.~&502817364213021138&~.~&214641137009&~ / 2){
        ~&492388835821912021&~();

    }
    ~&6504254477&~.~&502817364213021138&~.~&8399804544299345782&~(~&5971598&~.~&214638019283&~(0, offsetFromNearScrollCenter > 1 && offsetFromNearScrollCenter < ~&2143280150739709578&~ ? -offsetFromNearScrollCenter : -~&2143280150739709578&~));

function scrollUpOrChangePage() {
